note: Barton County, MO publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (GeneralZoningMap-Adopted Dec 2 2025). Its GIS data is sold by fee (.dwg/.shp), not a queryable service. The county assessor's GIS viewer (barton.samgis.biz) and ORKA viewer expose no zoning layer. Lamar's zoning ordinance says the official district map is kept by the City Clerk; no city ArcGIS layer was found. ArcGIS searches for Barton County zoning returned nothing usable.
